title: Insulated Outdoor Cat House on Legs – Raised From Cold and Wet Ground
seo_title: Insulated Outdoor Cat House on Legs
seo_description: Insulated outdoor cat house on a stand with four legs – keeps the cold from below and the wind out. Sleeping mat included, folds up.
descriptionHtml:
The cat is sleeping under the car again

You see it slip in under the deck when it rains, or lie curled up on a cold concrete step. There is no dry spot on the property that is the cat's own, and every time the temperature creeps down you stand at the window wondering where it went.

A place of its own that keeps the cold from below and the wind out

The house stands raised on a stand with four legs, so the cold from the ground is kept away from the floor. The roof extends over the arched entrance with a flap that shuts out the wind, the fabric is Oxford quality, and the walls are insulated so the warmth the cat gives off stays in. The sleeping mat goes in the bottom – a place of its own for the cat, instead of under the car.

Features

  • The cold from the ground stays outside – the house stands raised on a stand with four legs
  • The entrance sits sheltered under the roof – the roof extends over the arched opening with a flap
  • Keeps the warmth the cat gives off – insulated walls, not thin fabric
  • No need to buy a cushion of your own – sleeping mat in the bottom included
  • Takes up less space in the shed over the summer – the house folds up when the season is over
